name: Purewell Gravity Water Filter System
imageAlt: Illustration of a stainless steel countertop gravity water filter
description: Purewell says it reduces PFAS; it lists NSF/ANSI 42 and 372 certifications, which cover taste/odor and lead-free materials, not PFAS reduction. Model SF-CT-2.25G is a 7-stage gravity water filter with a water level window.
features: Filter Compatibility - The Upgraded 7-Stage TDS Filter is compatible with Purewell SF Series filtration systems as well as Zero pitchers and dispensers. Likewise, Zero filters are also compatible with our filtration system. However, beyond these, our upgraded filters are not compatible with other filtration systems. This filter is not sourced by or sponsored by Zero. Purewell is an independent brand.

Purewell says this gravity system can reduce total dissolved solids, including calcium and magnesium, and that the filter twists in without a reverse osmosis install. It lists NSF/ANSI 42 and 372 certifications, which cover taste/odor and lead-free materials, not TDS reduction.

Purewell says it reduces PFAS; it lists NSF/ANSI 42 and 372 certifications, which cover taste/odor and lead-free materials, not PFAS reduction. NSF/ANSI 372 is a lead-free materials standard, not a certification that the filter reduces lead, chlorine, or mercury.

Upgraded 7-stage filter: Purewell says the cartridge combines a pre-filter mesh, three layers of PP cotton, activated carbon, silver ions, KDF, and TDS reduction media, and that it removes up to 99.9% of residual chlorine while blocking rust, sediment, organic compounds, and heavy metals. That description is Purewell's, not an NSF/ANSI 42 or 372 reduction claim for PFAS, lead, or TDS.

4X Longer Lifespan - Each TDS filter delivers up to 100 gallons of clean drinking water and contains over 4 times more filtration media than replacement filters from Zero and other brands—resulting in a lifespan that's more than 4 times longer. It supports your daily hydration needs while reducing the hassle of frequent replacements. However, actual lifespan may vary depending on your local water quality. For optimal performance, we recommend replacing the filter every month.

Newly Designed Water Level Window - This Purewell stainless steel filtration system features a newly designed transparent water level window. It allows you to monitor the remaining water at a glance—no need to lift the lid or move the upper chamber. Whether you're using it in the kitchen, office, or outdoors, this convenient feature ensures timely refills, eliminates guesswork, and enhances your overall water usage experience.
